phase_title: The source-exact K+, its missing bridge, and the faithful dichotomy carrier
summary: Phase 10.1 complete. Landed Kamp/KPlusFaithful.lean (710 lines, 33 declarations, sorry-free, axiom-clean): kplusOpen/kminusOpen as the Prop-level reading of the already-existing Formula.kPlus/kMinus; the bridge lemmas kPlus_formula_correct/kMinus_formula_correct that the tree has never had; HasFaithfulDedekindINF/SUP (Rabinovich eq (5.2) with its left disjunct at the source's conjunct-free K+); prior_hasFaithfulDedekindINF_dense/SUP from SemanticPriorU/SemanticPriorS with NO guard and NO endpoint disjunct; the one-way shim lattice with the missing edge recorded and witnessed; and both anti-vacuity halves including v8's re-base corollary. THE PROBE RAN AND R11 HELD. Also landed the two chartered comment-bytes-only attribution corrections, verified comment-only by a nesting-aware comment stripper. Full lake build green (1919 jobs). Sorry census outside Boneyard/ unchanged at exactly Transfer.lean:1242. All three canaries unchanged. All frozen assets byte-identical.

r11_outcome.detail: hasFaithfulDedekindINF_survives_interval_witness (Kamp/KPlusFaithful.lean) takes EXACTLY the hypotheses of hasDedekindINF_fails_of_interval_witness (DedekindINFDense.lean:455) -- densely ordered flow, P true at z0, P true throughout (z0,z1) -- and concludes `kplusOpen M atomMap P z0 AND NOT HasDedekindINF M atomMap`. Sorry-free, axioms [propext]. The interval-witness refutation therefore does NOT survive the conjunct-free antecedent: at the very configuration that refutes the tree's carrier, the source-exact carrier's left disjunct HOLDS, so there is no failure to refute. The general fact is isolated as kplusOpen_of_interval_witness and is STRONGER than the probe required -- TemporalTruth M atomMap z0 P is not used at all; density plus 'P throughout (z0,z1)' already yields kplusOpen P z0. Concretely: denseWindow_kplusOpen_at_half and denseWindow_probe_verdict establish, at denseWindowFlow with z0=1/2, z1=1 (the exact point where denseWindow_endpoint_disjunct_forced, DedekindINFDense.lean:595, proves P(z0) holds and BOTH of HasDedekindINF's disjuncts fail), that the structure satisfies SemanticPriorU, SemanticPriorS, P(1/2), kplusOpen P (1/2), and NOT HasDedekindINF. In the plan's own words: 'the guard/trichotomy apparatus is a repair for the tree's kplus and is not needed by a source-exact carrier.'
r11_outcome.consequence_for_phase_11_and_12: The chartered trichotomy fallback is NOT triggered. Phases 12 and 12.1 do NOT need explicit endpoint branches at NegFixOneFaithful.lean:422 / NegFixListFaithful.lean:446, and Block D proceeds on the PRIMARY charter: re-base the eight faithful modules onto HasFaithfulDedekindINF/SUP by hypothesis swap, in import-chain order, one bounded unit per phase. IMPORTANT SCOPE LIMIT, stated so it is not over-read: R11 as landed here settles the CARRIER-level claim (the faithful carrier is a genuine dichotomy on exactly the configuration that broke the two-disjunct form). It does NOT yet prove the CONSUMER-level claim that negChainOnFaithful_iff (Lemma53Faithful.lean:274) keeps its two-arm shape under the swap. That measurement remains Phase 11's first deliverable exactly as chartered by the plan. The evidence carried into it is unchanged and now stronger: the R12 audit was re-run and confirmed (no faithful-family consumer projects kplus's .1), and HasDedekindINF.toHasFaithfulDedekindINF keeps every existing supplier -- including the whole discrete pipeline via HasAttainedINF.toHasDedekindINF -- working through the swap.

route_critical_findings.finding: R11 HELD. The source-exact, conjunct-free K+ turns Phase 10's trichotomy back into a two-arm dichotomy at the carrier level. The guard, the third disjunct P(z0) and the trichotomy are a formalization-level repair for this tree's kplus, machine-checked, not dense-case mathematical content.

R12 re-audited and confirmed. Exactly three sites outside Boneyard/ project a kplus/kminus hypothesis's first component -- DedekindINFDense.lean:467, :486, :609 -- all inside that module's own refutation machinery, i.e. inside the apparatus that exists BECAUSE of the conjunct. Every faithful-family consumer discards it. Anchor drift recorded: orderedPointsExist_combine_kplus's destructure is at Lemma53Faithful.lean:143, not :137 as the v8 survey states; Lemma53.lean:296 and Lemma53FaithfulPast.lean:339 confirmed exactly.

The tree now has ZERO unbridged K+ spellings. Formula.kPlus/kMinus stood since they were written with a name-collision warning and no lemma relating either to a truth condition, while Axiom.prior_U_gap (Axioms.lean:377), Axiom.prior_S_gap (:387) and Axiom.sep (:390) are all stated with them. kPlus_formula_correct / kMinus_formula_correct close that gap and are independently valuable to any later phase -- notably Phase 23, where Axiom.sep becomes load-bearing for the first time.

The plan's Phase 10.1 task list states the relating lemma `(TemporalTruth M atomMap t P OR kplus M atomMap P t) -> kplusOpen M atomMap P t`. That arrow is NOT a theorem: P(t) does not imply kplusOpen P t. The plan's own parenthetical on the same line ('a machine-checked witness that the converse fails (a point where P holds and P does not occur arbitrarily soon after)') describes the counterexample to exactly that direction, so the intended content is unambiguous and was landed in full: truth_or_kplus_of_kplusOpen (the true direction, kplusOpen -> P(t) OR kplus P t, which the shim lattice needs) plus kplusOpen_not_implied_by_truth_at (the machine-checked failure of the stated direction, at denseClosedRayFlow, t=0). Nothing weakened, nothing skipped. Annotated inline in the plan and reported here rather than absorbed silently. A future plan revision should turn the arrow around.

The abbreviation table was read VERBATIM from the corpus (~/Projects/Literature/sources/reynolds_1992/sec01_an-axiomatization-for-until-and-since-ov.md): 'K^+ A | for not U(top, not A) | A will be true arbitrarily soon', with K^- A for not S(top, not A), and U/S truth clauses matching Formula.untl/snce's argument order.
